# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip }}

Hedgehog Bits is an iPhone app ({{ site.app.os_requirement }}). It opens with the question "What's your name?". Typing the vault password opens an encrypted vault; any other answer opens six brain games. All data stays on the device. There is no server, account, sync, analytics, advertising or password recovery.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, {{ site.app.os_requirement }}. Works fully offline.
- Stores: notes, photos, videos, audio, PDFs, text and other files, in folders.
- Encryption: Argon2id (256 MiB, 3 passes) password key; random 256-bit master key wrapped with AES-256-GCM; per-item HKDF-SHA256 keys; AES-256-GCM in authenticated 1 MiB chunks.
- Storage: on the device only; excluded from iCloud backups, computer backups and Quick Start transfer; iOS FileProtection.complete.
- Backup: manual export to one encrypted `.hhbits` file, protected by an HMAC; all-or-nothing restore on a new iPhone.
- Forgotten password: the vault cannot be recovered by anyone.
- Availability: {% if site.app_store_url != "" %}[App Store]({{ site.app_store_url }}){% else %}coming soon to the App Store{% endif %}.
